body_markdown:
**Key takeaways:**


- AI Receptionist, 24/7 AI call-answering feature, is now included in the AT&T Office@Hand Ultimate package.
- Real estate agents on AT&T Office@Hand can answer every call instantly, route urgent leads, and book tours automatically, without adding a separate tool.
- It works inside the phone system you already have, so there’s nothing new to set up outside your existing AT&T Office@Hand account.


You’re a real estate agent in the middle of a high-stakes closing negotiation. Your phone buzzes in your pocket. It’s an unknown number. On the other end is a buyer standing outside your newest listing, looking at the sign. They are ready to request a private walkthrough, right now. You can’t answer.


The caller listens to four rings, hits your voicemail, and hangs up without leaving a message. Thirty seconds later, they’re on Zillow calling the next agent down the list. By the time you step out of your meeting, that buyer has already scheduled a viewing with your competitor.


In real estate, the agent who answers first usually gets the client.


## What’s new: AI Receptionist is now part of AT&T Office@Hand Ultimate Package


AT&T Office@Hand now includes AI Receptionist as part of its Ultimate package. If you’re already using AT&T Office@Hand for calls and texts, a 24/7 AI-powered front desk is available inside the same phone system, with nothing extra to buy or set up separately. You can also purchase AI Receptionist via the Admin Portal as a separate add-on.


## What does a missed call cost a real estate agent?


Buyers looking for a walkthrough and tenants seeking rental availability want a response right away. An unanswered call represents far more than just a missed phone ring:


- **Lost commission and deals** : One missed call could be a high-value home buyer or a property owner looking for a listing agent.
- **Wasted marketing dollars** : You invested in digital ads, yard signs, and local listings to make your phone ring? Letting those calls go to voicemail burns through your marketing ROI.
- **Damaged first impressions** : Buyers and sellers judge your reliability by how fast you respond. If you aren’t available at the first point of contact, they’ll assume you’ll be hard to reach during a closing.


They’re on to the next agent. And you can’t sit by your phone 24/7, but you also can’t afford to let potential buyers walk directly to your competition.


## How can real estate agents stop missing calls?


Once it’s active, AI Receptionist gives every inbound call immediate, professional attention, acting as a 24/7 extension of your real estate business, so prospective clients never land in a generic voicemail box.


## How AI Receptionist works inside AT&T Office@Hand for real estate agents


Here’s what AI Receptionist does for real estate agents once it’s part of your AT&T Office@Hand plan:


**Real estate requirements** **What an AI Receptionist does for your real estate business**


**Instant engagement** Answers incoming calls immediately, engaging prospects while their interest is at its peak.


**Intelligent routing and filtering** Answers routine questions (property details, open house hours) and routes high-priority calls straight to your mobile device.


**Seamless scheduling** Integrates with Outlook and Google Calendar to help coordinate property tours, buyer consultations, and follow-up meetings based on your availability. Prospects can take the next step while their interest is highest, even when you’re busy helping other clients.


**Unified mobile experience** You access all business voice, text, and call summaries from a single mobile app while on the go. No need to toggle between apps.


Being there when your clients need you most is what separates closed deals from lost ones. If you’re already on AT&T Office@Hand, AI Receptionist gives you that without switching phone systems or adding new tools, you protect your pipeline, maximize your lead generation efforts, and keep the next deal in your hands.


## Frequently asked questions


**What is an AI Receptionist in AT&T Office@Hand?**


AI Receptionist is Office@Hand’s 24/7 virtual assistant, now included in the AT&T Office@Hand Ultimate package. It answers every incoming call, handles routine questions like property details and open house hours, routes urgent calls straight to your phone, and books property tours on your calendar automatically.


**Do I need to buy a separate tool to get AI Receptionist on AT&T Office@Hand?**


No. It’s included in the AT&T Office@Hand Ultimate package, so if you’re already on that plan, it’s available inside your existing phone system. If you do not have the Ultimate package, you can purchase AI Receptionist via the Admin Portal.


**How much does a missed call cost a real estate agent?**


A single missed call can mean a lost commission, wasted spend on the ads and listings that made the phone ring in the first place, and a bad first impression with a buyer or seller who expected a faster response.
